artists.name: Naomi Siolo
artists.tagline: "Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding."  — Proverbs 3:5-6
artists.bio:
Naomi Siolo is a solo Christian pop singer and songwriter. Starting by sharing original songs online, Naomi blends uplifting melodies with heartfelt lyrics that reflect her faith.

What she does: writes all of her music independently, creating inspiring Christian pop songs that encourage hope, worship, and a deeper connection with God.
